content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the agreement and have a few suggested changes to the relevant clauses before signing.

- The relevant clause states that invoices are payable Net 90, which is longer than the maximum allowed. I propose changing this to: Invoices are payable Net 30.
- The relevant clause specifies a Payment period of Net 90, which requires waiting 90 days after invoicing before payment, longer than the standard 30 days. I propose changing this to: Payment period: Net 30.

Let me know if these modifications are acceptable.

Best regards
